## Code

### P3 "Corner Colors" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Generates a gradient that fades between four different colors.; categories: Color; inputs: color1:color=[1,0,0,1], color2:color=[0,1,0,1], color3:color=[0,0,1,1], color4:color=[1,1,1,1], rotationAngle:float=0

```glsl
const float pi = 3.1415926535897932384626433832795;

vec2 rotatePointNorm(vec2 pt, float rot)	{
	vec2 returnMe = pt;

	float r = distance(vec2(0.50), returnMe);
	float a = atan((returnMe.y-0.5),(returnMe.x-0.5));

	returnMe.x = r * cos(a + 2.0 * pi * rot - pi) + 0.5;
	returnMe.y = r * sin(a + 2.0 * pi * rot - pi) + 0.5;
	
	returnMe = returnMe;
	
	return returnMe;
}

void main()	{
	vec4		inputPixelColor = vec4(0.0);
	vec4		dist = vec4(0.0);
	vec2		pt = isf_FragNormCoord;
	pt = rotatePointNorm(pt,rotationAngle+0.5);
	dist.r = max(1.0-distance(vec2(0.0,0.0),pt),0.0);
	dist.g = max(1.0-distance(vec2(1.0,0.0),pt),0.0);
	dist.b = max(1.0-distance(vec2(0.0,1.0),pt),0.0);
	dist.a = max(1.0-distance(vec2(1.0,1.0),pt),0.0);
	
	inputPixelColor = (color1 * dist.r + color2 * dist.g + color3 * dist.b + color4 * dist.a) / (dist.r + dist.g + dist.b + dist.a);
	
	gl_FragColor = inputPixelColor;
}
```

### P4 "Noise" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: Generates random RGB noise in a read-write image; categories: GENERATOR, NOISE; resources: NoiseBuffer:storage

```glsl
float hash(uint seed) {
    seed ^= seed >> 17u;
    seed *= 0xed5ad4bbu;
    seed ^= seed >> 11u;
    seed *= 0xac4c1b51u;
    seed ^= seed >> 15u;
    seed *= 0x31848babu;
    seed ^= seed >> 14u;
    return float(seed) / 4294967296.0;
}

float randomFloat(uint seed) {
    return hash(seed) * 100.0 - 50.0;
}

void main() 
{
    uint totalX = gl_NumWorkGroups.x * gl_WorkGroupSize.x;
    uint totalY = gl_NumWorkGroups.y * gl_WorkGroupSize.y;
    
    uint globalIndex = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x + 
                       gl_GlobalInvocationID.y * totalX + 
                       gl_GlobalInvocationID.z * totalX * totalY;
    
    uint size = uint(NoiseBuffer.float_array.length());
    
    // Each invocation handles 24 floats (8 points)
    uint coord = 64u * globalIndex;
     
    if (coord + 63u >= size)
        return;
    
    uint timeSeed = uint(TIME * 1000.0);
    
    // Generate 24 floats (8 xyz points)
    for(int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        uint seed = (coord + uint(i)) * 747796405u + timeSeed * 2891336453u;
        NoiseBuffer.float_array[coord + uint(i)] = randomFloat(seed);
    }
}
```
